final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS BytesPerMillisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT MediaTypeName, BytesPerMillisecond, BytesPerMillisecond / AVG(BytesPerMillisecond) OVER () AS RelativeToMediaTypeAverage FROM media_rates ORDER BY MediaTypeName
